title: Street-Level AI: Are Large Language Models Ready for Real-World Judgments?
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The research focuses entirely on the ethical and practical implications of using LLMs for social resource allocation in the context of homelessness, without analyzing religious factors.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus was on evaluating LLM judgments in the context of homelessness resource allocation, specifically their consistency, alignment with human judgments, and alignment with existing bureaucratic scoring systems.
